from orders import load_orders, ROWS
from register import OrderBook


def test_total_after_add():
    rows = list(load_orders())
    book = OrderBook()
    book.add(rows[0])
    assert book.total() == ROWS[0][1]
    book.add(rows[1])
    assert book.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]


def test_total_once():
    book = OrderBook()
    for x in load_orders():
        book.add(x)
    assert book.total() == sum(v for _, v in ROWS)

def test_total_after_every_add():
    book = OrderBook()
    running = 0
    for x in load_orders():
        book.add(x)
        running += x.amount
        assert book.total() == running
